meta.title: A week of ideas worth revisiting
meta.time_basis: Post creation time; like timestamps are unavailable
meta.coverage: Fictional review dataset: 6 posts, 2 collections, no live account data

overview: Six fictional posts illustrate a personal reading brief: practical AI workflows, evidence-led research, clear product design, and account-access boundaries. Every finding links back to the included evidence.

findings.title: Move from collecting to testing
findings.summary: The examples connect saved AI ideas with small experiments and a source-linked topic index.

findings.title: Keep uncertainty in the picture
findings.summary: Research context and missing metrics are preserved, so the report does not overstate what the sample can show.

findings.title: Design for a clear next step
findings.summary: Recovery copy and account-access explanations reduce confusion without hiding the underlying limitation.

limitations: All names, posts, metrics, and source destinations in this preview are fictional.
The date window describes post creation, not when a user liked or viewed the content.
One post has an unavailable like count and is listed after posts with known counts. The two posts tied at 430 likes are ordered by creation time.

posts.author: @sample_builder
posts.headline: Turn saved posts into small experiments
posts.summary: A practical workflow moves from collecting AI tips to writing one testable experiment for each saved idea.
posts.excerpt: Save the source, name the experiment, and record what changed.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.

posts.author: @sample_researcher
posts.headline: Read the evidence behind a promising result
posts.summary: A research note separates a paper’s reported result from the dataset, baseline, and evaluation needed to interpret it.
posts.excerpt: A headline result becomes useful when the baseline and test conditions are clear.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.

posts.author: @sample_designer
posts.headline: Make an empty state offer one next action
posts.summary: An interface example replaces a vague error with a clear explanation and a way to recover without losing context.
posts.excerpt: Show what this space is for and one useful next action.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.

posts.author: @sample_security
posts.headline: Separate service sign-in from account permission
posts.summary: A security explainer distinguishes signing into a service from authorizing that service to read another account.
posts.excerpt: A working service login does not identify every connected social account.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.

posts.author: @sample_organizer
posts.headline: Keep a topic index with links back to sources
posts.summary: A lightweight index groups saved ideas by intended use while retaining links to the original context.
posts.excerpt: Useful categories describe what you might do with an idea.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.

posts.author: @sample_evaluator
posts.headline: Leave unavailable metrics visibly unknown
posts.summary: An evaluation note explains why missing engagement values should remain unknown rather than becoming zero in a ranking.
posts.excerpt: Unknown is a data state, not a low score.
notes: Fictional post created only to review the report layout.
